description: This file contains CMake macro definitions used for building and linking libraries, generating parser code, and setting target properties in a CMake-based build system for the lighttpd project.

methods.name: ADD_AND_INSTALL_LIBRARY
methods.description: Defines a macro to add static, shared, or module libraries based on build configuration and sets up necessary linkages and properties.

methods.name: LEMON_PARSER
methods.description: Defines a macro to generate parser source and header files from a Lemon grammar source file.

methods.name: ADD_TARGET_PROPERTIES
methods.description: Defines a macro to add properties to a specified build target.
